_schema_note: This is a REDACTED PUBLIC manifest. It intentionally omits internal authorship metadata (agent names, ticket IDs, private branch names) and reports rule changes at capability level, not exact pattern/matching mechanics. See ../../SECURITY.md for why. The full internal manifest (with exact detection-logic change notes, e.g. specific metavariable constraints and sink-binding structure) is not published.
relationship_to_baseline: This is a REMEDIATION re-run against the exact same frozen ground-truth.csv and the exact same pinned DVAA/DVMCP targets as the v0.1 baseline (see benchmark-manifest.json). Only the Noviscent rule commit changed. The v0.1 baseline evidence (evidence/raw/baseline/, evidence/triage/triage-log-baseline-reconciled.csv) is NOT modified or overwritten by this file or by evidence/raw/v0.1.1/ -- both are preserved side by side. This is a same-corpus regression/remediation result, not independent validation -- see REPRODUCIBILITY.md and results/remediation-v0.1.1.md.

noviscent_ai_sast.note: Two-commit provenance model: remediation_commit_sha is the rules-under-test commit the benchmark was run against. The manifest and evidence files are captured in a later commit. This regeneration reflects rule-pack content changes only; no changes were made to ground-truth.csv, the scoring methodology, or the pinned DVAA/DVMCP target commits.

scanner.install_method: pip install semgrep, isolated venv (unchanged from baseline)

content_sha256_method: sha256 of the concatenation of every *.yaml semgrep rule file and pack.json in the pack directory, in sorted path order (identical method to the baseline manifest).
rule_changes_summary: Command-injection detection (tool-safety pack): coverage broadened across previously-missed execution shapes -- was scoped too narrowly to specific framework call patterns.
Unsandboxed code-execution detection (agent-safety pack): extended to recognize additional tool-registration decorator shapes and a temp-file-then-execute pattern that was previously missed.
Agent-delegation privilege-escalation detection (agent-safety pack): extended to the language/transport actually exercised by the corpus (was single-framework, single-language).

Path-traversal detection (tool-safety pack): input-source narrowness fixed (same root cause as the command-injection fix); sanitizer-recognition logic tightened after review found it was accepting insufficiently-validated patterns as safe.
Prompt-injection heuristic (prompt-rag pack): narrowed to reduce false positives -- was matching generic string construction unrelated to prompt composition.

New rule (agent-safety pack): detects MCP/LangChain tool docstrings/descriptions containing embedded imperative instructions directed at the LLM ("tool poisoning") -- no prior coverage existed for this class.
New rule (supply-chain pack): detects unverified piped-install patterns (curl/wget into a shell) -- prior coverage was limited to a narrower set of install patterns.

Scoring/harness changes (not detection-rule changes): score-results.py now uses multiplicity-aware (not set-based) reproducibility comparison with a hard gate on any run-to-run mismatch; the pack test harness now treats positive-fixture failures as blocking for modified rules; a triage-vs-raw-output reconciliation check was added that aborts scoring on any mismatch.
scanned_paths: IDENTICAL to the baseline manifest's scanned_paths -- see evidence/manifests/benchmark-manifest.json.

ground_truth.statement: Completely unchanged from the frozen v0.1 baseline (identical sha256). This re-run scores the same 18 pre-declared scenarios (12 in-scope, 6 partial) against improved rules, not a redefinition of what counts as a hit.
